create_FoVPerspectiveCameras: create a FoVPerspectiveCameras instance with custom fov, znear, zfar, aspect ratio, and extrinsics R and T
create_PerspectiveCameras: create a PerspectiveCameras instance with focal length, principal point, and optional image size for NDC or screen space
transform_points: transform 3D world points to camera NDC or screen space using a camera's full projection transform
unproject_points: unproject 2D image points with depth back to 3D world or camera view coordinates
look_at_view_transform: compute rotation and translation matrices for a look-at camera given distance, elevation, and azimuth angles
